name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the fastest way to cut manual review cycles while keeping quality high—trade-off is dependency on external skills, but the pack is open-source and designed for this exact use case.

name: Gauge
text: The Skill Pack’s "automated prompt tuning" is a black box—we’d trade drift risk for speed. A 5% canary still exposes 1 in 20 users to a broken prompt—enough to damage trust. Instead, audit the prompts first, then automate only the safe, rule-based tweaks. Settle it by running a 1% canary for a week with manual fallback.

name: Sprocket
text:
Adopt the **24-hour canary deployment to 5% of users** first. It’s the fastest way to validate prompt changes without full exposure—trade-off is risking 1 in 20 users seeing a bad prompt, but we catch issues quickly and roll back. The Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack can automate safe tweaks later, but we need real-world data first to avoid blind automation.

name: Gauge
text: Gauge: A 5% canary still risks reputational damage if the broken prompt triggers user complaints before we detect it—speed doesn’t justify that. Instead, run a 0.1% canary for 48 hours with strict error-rate thresholds; if it passes, scale to 1%. That balances speed with safety.
